Class TeamBugemon

java.lang.Object
models.bugemon.TeamBugemon
All Implemented Interfaces:
TeamBugemonDTO
public class TeamBugemon extends Object implements TeamBugemonDTO
Represents a named team of up to 6 Bugémons. Implements TeamBugemonDTO to expose read-only data to views.
